note: This plan was written after hardware collection. It is not a preregistered protocol.
seed_rule: numpy.random.RandomState(seed_root + 1000 * fixture_index). Seeds are frozen in this file before outcomes are computed.
replication_count_justification: 32 inexpensive Monte Carlo replications to report sampling uncertainty on six-variable instances. These are not extra physical jobs or organisations.
shared_across_qaoa_depth_disclosure: The same classical pools are reused for p=1 and p=2 comparison panels because the controls do not depend on QAOA depth. Do not treat duplicated controls as independent experiments.
analytical_opt_containment: For independent draws from a fixed distribution, P(at least one optimum in m shots) = 1-(1-p_opt)^m. Support size 64 alone does not imply that 1024 draws generally contain an optimum.
cost_disclaimer: Matched sample counts are not equal wall-clock or monetary costs. Exact enumeration examines each of 64 unique states once.
